title: The Human Body
description: What is inside you, what it does, and a few numbers worth knowing.

cards.front: Which organ pumps blood around your body?
Which organs do you breathe with?
Which organ does your thinking?
What is the biggest organ of your body?
cards.note: It is an organ too — it keeps water in and germs out.

cards.front: What holds your body up and gives it its shape?
What pulls on your bones to make you move?
What do we call the place where two bones meet?
cards.hint: Your knee and your elbow are two

cards.front: Which bone protects your brain?
Which bones protect your heart and lungs?
What is the longest bone in your body?
How many bones does a grown-up have?
cards.note: A baby is born with about 300; many join together as it grows.

cards.front: What carries blood away from the heart?
What carries blood back to the heart?
What does blood carry to every part of the body?
Which part of the blood fights germs?
Which part of the blood carries oxygen?
Where does food go right after you swallow it?
cards.note: Down a tube called the oesophagus first.

cards.front: Which organ cleans your blood and makes urine?
Which big organ cleans poisons out of your blood and stores energy?
What carries messages between your brain and your body?
What are the five senses?
cards.back: Sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch

cards.front: Which part of the eye lets light in?
cards.note: The black dot in the middle; it gets bigger in the dark.

cards.front: What is the hard white coat on the outside of a tooth?
cards.note: The hardest thing in your body.

cards.front: How many teeth does a grown-up have?
What gas do we breathe in that our bodies need?
What gas do we breathe out?
About how much of your body is water?
What does your body do while you sleep?
cards.note: And the brain files away what you learned that day — which is why sleep helps you remember.
